applied.quote: Yes, UTMA money can pay for college, since it belongs to the child and can be spent on anything that benefits the child, including tuition.
applied.replacement: Yes, UTMA money can pay for college, since the custodian (then the child) can spend it on any purpose, including tuition.
applied.why: SOURCE says any purpose custodian (then child) chooses; child owns only at majority

applied.quote: A UTMA has no tax shelter, so selling holdings to cover a tuition bill can create capital gains taxed under the kiddie tax.
applied.replacement: Selling holdings to cover a tuition bill can trigger capital gains under the kiddie tax.
applied.why: Fact list lacks 'no tax shelter'; only says selling can trigger capital gains
